Why sun protection matters most
after a peel
After a peel, the outer skin layer becomes thinner and skin may become more sensitive to UV.
Consistent sun protection is recommended even after light peels.
Can I apply sunscreen on the day of an AquaPeel?
Yes, clinics usually advise applying it from the day of the procedure. The outer skin layer is thinner, so sun protection is especially important. If stinging is severe, check with your clinic first.
My skin is flaking after a peel. Can I do the rolling massage with the cleansing milk?
While your skin is flaking, keep the rolling massage short and light, and don't peel off flakes by hand. Spread it on without foaming and rinse with lukewarm water.
I only had LDM or LED. Is there anything special to watch for?
They usually cause almost no irritation, so you can use the sunscreen and cleansing milk as usual. If you had them along with another procedure, follow the guidance for that procedure.
